description: Gets an attached adapter and its per-cluster load state.

DE.AdapterEntry.description: Adapter attached to a deployment with desired revision and observed load state.

adapterModel.description: Resource name of the adapter model, using projects/{projectId}/models/{adapterModelId}.

adapterModelId.description: Adapter model identifier attached to the deployment.

desiredRevision.description: Resource name of the adapter model revision pinned on the deployment, using projects/{projectId}/models/{adapterModelId}/revisions/{revisionId}.

desiredRevisionId.description: Adapter revision pinned on the deployment.

etag.description: Row-level etag required for UpdateAdapter and RemoveAdapter.

perCluster.description: Per-cluster adapter load state reported by the controller.

DE.DeploymentAdapterStatus.description: Controller-reported load state for an adapter on one deployment cluster.

adapterModel.description: Resource name of the adapter model, using projects/{projectId}/models/{adapterModelId}.

adapterModelId.description: Adapter model identifier for this status row.

failedPodCount.description: Number of pods that failed to load the adapter.

loadedAt.description: Time when the adapter first reached READY in this cluster.

message.description: Human-readable details about the current adapter state.

readyPodCount.description: Number of pods with the adapter ready to serve.

realizedEtag.description: Adapter row etag observed by the controller when it wrote this status.

realizedRevision.description: Resource name of the adapter model revision currently loaded in this cluster, using projects/{projectId}/models/{adapterModelId}/revisions/{revisionId}.

realizedRevisionId.description: Adapter revision currently loaded on pods in this cluster.

reason.description: Stable reason code for the current adapter state.

state.description: Current adapter load state in this cluster.

totalPodCount.description: Total pods expected to report adapter load state.

updatedAt.description: Time when this adapter status was last updated.
